engineering_interval.interpretation: fixed-corpus paired variation summary, not population inference

primary_decision_rule.insufficient_safe_capture_opportunities: either candidate has fewer than 30 observed safe capture opportunity turns

analysis.primary_estimand: mean across matched start/color units of v4 minus v3 per-game missed-safe-capture turns divided by all candidate turns
secondary_metrics: chosen capture rate with candidate-turn denominator
safe capture opportunity exposure and selection conditional on opportunity
post-total-logical-ply-120 safe capture opportunity and selection counts
local BoardState FEN revisit and WDL-preserving novel-alternative counts
analysis.unit: one source record and one candidate color with paired retained-v3 and no-refresh-v4 completed games

definitions.board_revisit: chosen local BoardState FEN already appeared at the frozen prefix endpoint or in the audited post-prefix suffix; not a strict threefold adjudication
definitions.missed_safe_capture: a safe capture opportunity exists but the recorded choice is not a WDL-preserving capture
definitions.safe_capture_opportunity: at least one complete legal capture preserves exact parent coarse Malom W/D/L and therefore resets the strict no-capture clock without a W/D/L downgrade
definitions.safe_novel_opportunity: at least one W/D/L-preserving legal move reaches a local BoardState FEN not seen at the frozen prefix endpoint or in the audited post-prefix suffix

objective: Determine whether the observed retained-v4 prolongation on the completed development diagnostic is associated with lower exposure to, or lower selection of, Malom-WDL-preserving capture opportunities, without playing another game.
